title: vtc-00: no error for E2EE dial-out
description: Dial-out errors (draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md:1001) do not cover E2EE calls, though :1562 forbids paths to plaintext except key-holding participants. Recording and livestream already return forbidden.
close_reason: Dial-out on E2EE call without key-holding gateway rejected with forbidden, by reference to the existing E2EE rule (no new MUST).
